newsitem.title: USA: IPALCO kilowatt hour sales up in '96.
newsitem.headline: IPALCO kilowatt hour sales up in '96.

text.p: IPALCO Enterprises Inc said retail kilowatt hour sales at its Indianapolis Power & Light Co increased 2.1 percent in 1996, reflecting continued economic strength in Indianapolis and favorable winter weather early in the season as measured by heating degree days.
Heating degree days increased nearly six percent over 1995, it said. Kilowatt hour sales were flat in the fourth quarter due to milder weather.

Earlier Tuesday the utility posted fourth-quarter earnings per share of $0.30, up from $0.20. Operating revenues gained to $182.8 million from $174.2 million. Full-year earnings advanced to $2.01 from $1.74 and operating revenues rose to $762.5 million from $709.2 million.
